cards.ex: I had to call in sick yesterday because I had a terrible headache.
cards.exUz: Kecha boshim qattiq og'rigani uchun kasalman deb aytishga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Ishga kasal bo'lganligi sababli kelmasligini aytish.

cards.ex: I'm taking on extra responsibilities at work this month.
cards.exUz: Men bu oy ishda qo'shimcha mas'uliyatlarni o'z zimmamga olyapman.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki vazifani o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: I've been working overtime every night this week to meet the deadline.
cards.exUz: Men bu hafta har kecha muddatga yetib olish uchun qo'shimcha ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan vaqtdan ko'proq ishlash, odatda pul evaziga.

cards.ex: Can you fill in for me while I'm on vacation?
cards.exUz: Men ta'tilda bo'lganimda o'rniga ishlay olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Kimdir ishda yo'qligida uning vazifalarini bajarish.

cards.ex: He got the sack for constantly being late.
cards.exUz: U doimiy ravishda kechikkani uchun ishdan bo'shatildi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan yomon ish faoliyati yoki xatti-harakatlari uchun bo'shatilish.

cards.ex: She finally landed a job at a tech company.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat texnologiya kompaniyasida ishga joylashdi.
cards.uzDef: Ish izlashda muvaffaqiyat qozonib, ishga qabul qilinish.

cards.ex: I've been working like a dog to get this project finished.
cards.exUz: Men bu loyihani tugatish uchun itdek ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va uzoq vaqt ishlash.

cards.ex: As the manager, she gets to call the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Menejer sifatida u bu yerda buyruq beradi.
cards.uzDef: Katta qarorlar qabul qilish va vaziyatni nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: He's determined to climb the ladder at his company.
cards.exUz: U o'z kompaniyasida martaba o'sishiga qat'iy qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ishdagi martabada yuqoriroq lavozimlarga erishish.

cards.ex: I'm tired of the nine-to-five grind; I want to start my own business.
cards.exUz: Men ertalab 9 dan kechki 5 gacha bo'lgan ishdan charchadim, o'z biznesimni boshlamoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Odatda ertalab soat 9 dan kechki 5 gacha bo'lgan standart ish vaqti.

cards.ex: If you don't take breaks, you'll burn out quickly.
cards.exUz: Agar siz tanaffus qilmasangiz, tezda charchab qolasiz.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt stress va ortiqcha ishlashdan keyin charchab qolish va motivatsiyani yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The company cut corners on safety to save money.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pulni tejash uchun xavfsizlikda tejamkorlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun sifatga e'tibor bermaslik yoki qoidalarni buzish.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z mijozlari uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinganidan ko'proq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'd love to help, but my hands are tied by company policy.
cards.exUz: Men yordam berishni xohlardim, lekin kompaniya siyosati tufayli qo'lim bog'langan.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatda yordam bera olmaslik, chunki vakolati yo'q.

cards.ex: It's best to keep your head down during layoffs.
cards.exUz: Ishdan bo'shatish vaqtida past profil tutish yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat markazida bo'lmaslik va muammoga duch kelmaslik uchun ehtiyotkor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I was stuck in a dead-end job for years before I decided to go back to school.
cards.exUz: Men bir necha yil davomida istiqbolsiz ishda qolib ketdim, keyin o'qishga qaytishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday o'sish yoki rivojlanish imkoniyati bo'lmagan ish.

cards.ex: This new software has a steep learning curve.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi dasturiy ta'minotni o'rganish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani tez va qiyin o'rganishni talab qiladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: It's crunch time at the office; we have to finish this project by Friday.
cards.exUz: Ofisda qizg'in payt; biz bu loyihani juma kuniga qadar tugatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Loyihaning oxiriga yaqin qattiq ishlash vaqti.

cards.ex: Alright, let's get down to business and discuss the budget.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, keling, ishga kirishamiz va byudjetni muhokama qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Uchrashuv yoki ishni boshlash va asosiy mavzuga o'tish.

cards.ex: To solve this problem, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz noan'anaviy fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va ijodiy yechimlar topish uchun an'anaviy fikrlash usullaridan voz kechish.

cards.ex: Before we start, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
cards.exUz: Boshlashdan oldin, hammamiz bir xil narsani tushunayotganimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Hamma bir xil narsani tushunishi va kelishishi.

cards.ex: The project failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun boshidan boshlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi reja muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lgani uchun yangi reja bilan boshlash.

cards.ex: We need to cut through the red tape to get this project approved.
cards.exUz: Bu loyihani tasdiqlash uchun biz byurokratiyani yengishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat yoki tashkilot tomonidan qo'llaniladigan ortiqcha qoidalar va rasmiyatchiliklar.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cost of the project?
cards.exUz: Loyiha narxining taxminiy raqamini ayta olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan, lekin taxminiy qiymat.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to increase sales.
cards.exUz: Asosiy natija shundaki, biz sotuvni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yechim yoki vaziyatning eng muhim natijasi.

cards.ex: The new employee hit the ground running and quickly became a valuable asset.
cards.exUz: Yangi xodim tezda ishga kirishdi va tezda qimmatli aktivga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni darhol samarali boshlash.

cards.ex: I was out of the loop on that decision.
cards.exUz: Men bu qaror haqida xabardor emas edim.
cards.uzDef: Muhim ma'lumotlardan xabardor bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a little under the weather today, so I might work from home.
cards.exUz: Men bugun o'zimni biroz yomon his qilyapman, shuning uchun uydan ishlashim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kasal emas, lekin o'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik.

cards.ex: She worked hard and finally got a promotion.
cards.exUz: U qattiq ishladi va nihoyat lavozimga ko'tarildi.
cards.uzDef: Ishda yuqori lavozimga ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: Many employees got downsized during the economic recession.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy inqiroz davrida ko'plab xodimlar qisqartirildi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniya hajmini kamaytirish tufayli ishdan bo'shatilish.
